chapter_mission: Aevyn turns fully on Ben. His unstable cold white-blue blade becomes the first sustained lightsaber duel of the book. The duel happens across the collapsing Glasswell: rising water, cracking pale mineral, broken survey scaffolds, mirror-lake reflections, unstable holocron cache nearby, Aevyn’s cold white-blue unstable blade fracturing more visibly when his control strains, and Ben’s steadier Jedi blade. The fight is not simply Jedi versus dark sider. It is two students of Jacen arguing through action over what his lessons mean. Aevyn uses a technique that hits something buried in Ben — the corridor moment surfaces as a fragment for Aevyn here, never as exposition. Ben wins by using what Jacen taught him without surrendering ownership of himself. He does not violate Aevyn’s mind and does not pretend Jacen taught him nothing real.
chapter_turn: Aevyn is defeated as the Glasswell gives way.
